migration.name: none-required
migration.backfill: No migration and no backfill. Prisma models WorkCapsule and WorkCapsuleActivity are renamed to Workroom and WorkroomActivity, each carrying @@map to its original physical table name, so `prisma migrate diff --from-schema <old> --to-schema <new> --script` emits nothing and exits 0. The 285 live rows are untouched, no column is added, dropped, retyped or rewritten, and rollback is a source-only revert with no data step.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Logical rename only. The model keeps @@map("WorkCapsule"), so the physical table, its rows, its columns and its retention posture are identical before and after. The grandfathered stewardship-scope entry is carried across the rename in place rather than re-declared, keeping the gap count unchanged at 474 grandfathered / 116 stewarded across 590 models; no new retention disposition is invented, because the retention engine executes PURGE_POLICIES and a fabricated window on live work records would delete them. Rollback is forward-safe and data-free.

Logical rename only. Keeps @@map("WorkCapsuleActivity"). The immutable activity history is preserved byte-for-byte; no field is renamed in this phase, including the workCapsuleId foreign key, which stays until the field-vocabulary phase (BI-C2C16582).
